def compute_subset_sums(arr, mod):
    size = len(arr)
    sums_list = []
    total_masks = 1 << size
    
    for mask in range(total_masks):
        current_sum = 0
        for bit in range(size):
            if mask & (1 << bit):
                current_sum = (current_sum + arr[bit]) % mod
        sums_list.append(current_sum)
    
    return sums_list
